from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545201/attempts/077c639e3ede471faa305f8b7291dc1f/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max({v for row in grid for v in row}, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    regions = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            regions.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    patterns = []
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        patch = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
        if any(v != bg for row in patch for v in row):
            patterns.append(patch)
    if not patterns:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    pattern = patterns[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        if r1-r0 != len(pattern) or c1-c0 != len(pattern[0]):
            continue
        if all(out[r][c] == bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
            for dr in range(len(pattern)):
                out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = pattern[dr][:]
    return out
'''
